findings.passage: PA state Rep. Ben Waxman voted no on recent Republican legislation that would expand PA's voter ID law.
findings.note: Text on his official House page for a May 7, 2025 video, headed 'Waxman Says No to New Voter ID Legislation'. The same page says he states there is no evidence of widespread voter fraud in the commonwealth and that the legislation would only serve as an attempt to address conspiracy theories and outright lies. The bill number is not given on the page. The page text is a description of the video, not a transcript, and the video itself was not viewed.

findings.motion: Vote against 2025 House bill expanding Pennsylvania's voter ID law (bill number not stated on the page)
